'''Brambleblade Ravine''' is the home to the [[Bristleback tribe|Bristleback]] [[quilboar]]s found on the northeastern edge of [[Red Cloud Mesa]]. Early tauren adventurers journeyed here in order to disrupt the quilboar attacks, even to go as far as attacking their leader [[Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle]], who resided in a large hut towards the back of this ravine.
